notes.title: Kriegsfront Tactics Prologue - June 2024 Dev Milestone Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/4bfc6d9f4fa8add73ea1233577095fa724368172.png[/img]

[i][h3]Salute, Pilots![/h3][/i]
We are happy to inform you that our combat demo was a great success. A lot of positive responses and feedback were received from players who have tried it online and/or during events. Thank you so much!

If you have not tried the [b]Combat Demo[/b], please try it now [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350470]here[/url].

[h2]A Prologue Vertical Slice[/h2]
Now that we've delivered the turn-based tactical mecha combat, we've been working hard to add the RPG experience into our Procedural Tactical RPG and package it into one cohesive experience.

When we say RPG, we're not just talking about the stats and leveling mechanics; we're also talking about the world, the characters, the story, and other narrative elements that make a role-playing game great. Our team has been working non-stop to tie in all the mechanics into a playable vertical slice, and after many months, that RPG vertical slice is now almost complete.

With that said, we are happy to announce that we'll be releasing this vertical slice as a prologue on Steam for [b]FREE[/b]! It will be available for you to download on [b]July 18, 2024[/b].

Please tell your friends about it, and don't forget to add it to your [b]wishlist[/b] so that you'll be notified when it is available:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2851820

The prologue doesn't have the procedural system implemented yet (that will be for another milestone update), but here are the things that you'll find in this RPG vertical slice:

[h3]Prologue Story[/h3]
This vertical slice will serve as the prologue chapter, an opening introduction that kicks off the events that trigger the conflict in the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/b4eb5378dad50713b27a93698d75b558d93407a4.jpg[/img]

[h3]Mecha Customization & Stats[/h3]
You'll be able to customize your mechs and see how your pilots level up their skills.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/32ef052bf65bc84e846eb753d9e59a48f3f8a6f9.jpg[/img]
Not only that, you can change each mech's body parts and weapon load out, you can also customize their paint job and cosmetics.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/cb73a85d2558dc4e04bd0c9e4974c06e4639d85c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Exploration[/h3]
We've added a world exploration layer where you can roam around, discover new places, and encounter events that'll tell you a bit more about the characters and the world of Kriegsfront Tactics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/1c6cccd202c82a72623d327853abaafb1b9be98c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Voice Actors[/h3]
And what better way to bring those characters to life than hiring some of the best voice actors?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/878ac08919195faf3e0de723c374f46069d1b7c8.jpg[/img]

Here's the current list of Kriegsfront Tactics Voice Actors:  
[list]

[*] [url=https://x.com/UrbanLegendVO]Damon Alums [/url]

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/08adfb8040fc98e27de13a822da677d9c389ba33.png[/img]
Including this guy: Craig Lee Thomas' Helldivers 2 Spokesperson 

[h3]Wishlist the prologue![/h3]
Your support is once again required. Please wishlist the prologue so that more people will see it when it is out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2851820

Feel the urge to discuss Kriegsfront Tactics with other enthusiastic fans in the genre?

notes.title: Kriegsfront Tactics Devlog Series - Episode #1 Introduction
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/ec32d74adcbdc05b187762796358c30662cb9ace.jpg[/img]

[i][h3]Salute, Pilots![/h3][/i]
The Kriegsfront universe is expanding more than ever, [b] We are here to bring you a brand-new devlog series discussing all you know about Kriegsfront Tactics.[/b] 

This devlog is a behind-the-scenes series about the game development process of Kriegsfront Tactics, a grounded turn-based mecha tactics game set in an alternate world in 1970s Southeast Asia and inspired by classic titles such as Front Mission and Patlabor. As more updates are coming soon later this year, we'll be sharing tweaks, insights, and stories to keep our fans in the loop and keep up the hype. We would love to share many things with you, so you can know how dedicated we are to this project and bringing you the grounded mecha turn-based tactics we envisioned in 2018. 

In the first episode, Kris Antoni, the Game Director of Kriegsfront Tactics, will explore the basic foundation of the game that is comprehensible to our fans. Kris also serves as the founder of Toge Productions, an indie game development studio from Indonesia. Our humble beginnings that have garnered many fans from different parts of the world have enabled us to create new games and explore different genres, to the point we are now as we continue to develop Kriegsfront Tactics. 

[h3]Watch the first episode here to find out more![/h3]
[previewyoutube=v91Qa2Eg5yA;full][/previewyoutube]

The first episode consists of an introduction by our game director, and how Kriegsfront Tactics came to be realized in the first place. [b]You will know our game design pillars, inspiration, what's to come for the future, and why we are creating a turn-based mecha tactics game. [/b]You might discover new ideas about Kriegsfront Tactics, so be sure to watch the devlog until the end. 

Kris also will showcase the current progress and features of Kriegsfront Tactics and share some game development tips & tricks we have learned while developing the game. There are five topics to be covered in the first episode: 
1. Introduction
2. Background
3. Game Design
4. Visual Style
5. Roadmap

[b]If you want to see more of the Kriegsfront Tactics devlog, be sure to follow us! [/b]
Do you have anything in mind about other relevant topics you might be interested in? Please feel free to comment down below. 

[h3]Wishlist and Follow Kriegsfront Tactics for more! [/h3]

notes.title: Kriegsfront Tactics: Combat Teaser First Look
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/79ebf093f00f060879e2089a7ccdc0b86ba57b4b.png[/img]

[i][h3]Salute, Pilots! [/h3][/i]
Let’s welcome the new year of 2023 with a new exciting teaser! This is the first look at the newest combat gameplay from Kriegsfront Tactics.  

[b]Check out Kriegsfront Tactics Combat Trailer here[/b]
[previewyoutube=4cTQ8zFtgM8;full][/previewyoutube]

Nusanesia is a fictional archipelagic motherland in an alternate 1970s during an era of conflict. Foreign imperialists are fighting each other to gain abundant, untouched natural beauty and wealth.[b] Taking various aspects from real-life counterparts of Southeast Asia, we create a brand-new setting that involves mechs (read: Krieger).[/b] This is an era where the use of mechs is already at the same level as using heavy machinery. Kriegers exist with a pilot that can do construction work, materials extraction, transportation of goods, and the most profitable interest of them all, war. 

[b]Kriegsfront Tactics will offer turn-based mecha squad tactics with destructible mecha parts.[/b] If one of your parts breaks down, you can build it again using various parts from different manufacturers with their own specialty. [b]Experience a combination of classic tactical strategy games and roguelike elements like never before.[/b] Enjoy the lowpoly retro-style visuals that we handcrafted, where you can freely change the settings to be more classic or modern looking. 

[b][i]“We’re working hard to nail the combat aspect of the game, so both new and veteran players can enjoy the game. This is the progress so far and I hope you like it.”[/i][/b] - Ivan, Project Manager of Kriegsfront Tactics. 

We asked Ivan about the state of the game so far and he is positive about the game's progress. What is presented here is our work-in-progress following the timeline of the production which is still underway. We are excited to tease you with more content soon when it’s available. 

[b][h3]Community Closed Alpha Combat Playtest[/h3][/b]
Not so far in the future, we also will commence an exclusive close alpha combat playtest, [b]the first playable experience at the combat gameplay of Kriegsfront Tactics.[/b] This is a plan made for our community, who have been eagerly waiting for the game. 

As our community members are incredibly special to us, we want you to be able to experience firsthand the work of our Kriegsfront team. We value your opinion, and what you suggest could impact the future development of Kriegsfront Tactics. Be sure to hop on to the Toge Productions Discord server to stay updated on the latest developments and announcements!

[i][b]Join the Toge Productions Discord server here! [/b][/i]
[url=discord.gg/toge]Toge Productions Discord [/url]

[h3][b]Wishlist Kriegsfront Tactics on Steam now![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561740/Kriegsfront_Tactics/

Thank you for your support and positive feedback towards the team and after the release of Kriegsfront Battlescaper - Diorama Editor. We will continue to work to the best of our abilities to bring you the unique experience of using mechs in a hardly-seen-before setting.

See you soon, and godspeed, Pilots.

notes.title: Kriegsfront Battlescaper is Now Available to Play for Free!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=dHcGHT4qlbw;full][/previewyoutube]
Salute, Pilots!

Access the full version of Kriegsfront Tactics' main developer tool, [b]Kriegsfront Battlescaper - Diorama Editor FOR FREE![/b]  This utility tool was made from scratch with polished UI for the fans who are eagerly waiting for our upcoming game, Kriegsfront Tactics. Build your mecha with our improvised mecha (read: Krieger) builder, create different battlefield levels that include better features, and take the moment using the fully optimized photo editor! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41787510/32ef07a809a107361ed9778ec9b8194146bc657b.gif[/img]

[i]"It's such a waste if we can't share this tool with everyone with this much freedom!"[/i], said one of the dev crew. With this in mind, the dev team decided to work entirely on the developer tool, making it accessible for everyone, while also introducing the distinctive Kriegsfront universe. Feel free to let your creative ideas flow with this handy, user-friendly tool!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41787510/b06af44f750ee221707d7b609e8e0f38b73648e4.gif[/img]

Inspired by the concept of South East Asia environment and cultural influence back in the 1970s, enjoy the alternate history fantasy of the Kriegsfront universe. Where you are sent behind enemy lines and work around with what you have to survive. Feel more of the unique feeling by building a Krieger from four different manufacturers, as you can exchange each Krieger part to your needs.  

Which manufacturer will you prefer, or do you want to mix everything to make them as robust as possible?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41787510/5584743b59d6b52425cc910cdecc60d84c36af89.jpg[/img]

[h2]Come and let’s create your ideal mecha battle diorama.[/h2]

We would like to thank our community, who have been giving positive feedback and encouragement. Please keep supporting us in the future, as we are highly blessed by each of you.

We have set to launch Kriegsfront Battlescaper to the platform next week, on Thursday, August 4, 2022. 

Kriegsfront Battlescaper is a diorama editor originally set as a developer tool, where everyone can create their battlefield dioramas for the upcoming game, Kriegsfront Tactics. In Kriegsfront Battlescaper, you can build your unique mech in the Krieger builder, create different personalized levels with the level editor, and use the photo mode to show off your favorite scenes with other fans! 

Check out the video trailer for Kriegsfront Battlescaper Diorama Editor Launch Announcement.
[previewyoutube=dHcGHT4qlbw;full][/previewyoutube]

In this full version of the developer tool, you will have access to more assets and features you can play around with. Feel free to try them out and get a feel of what's it like in the Kriegsfront universe. Check out different mech parts from four manufacturers that separate them from one another. Build a level diorama with a nuance inspired by South East Asia's living conditions. Get more of it by taking pictures with new features that will make your photo stand out from another!

notes.title: Kriegsfront Battlescaper Demo is Available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41787510/5dbf0c2d7feebd70ddbb057c56ff5f2d11e1532c.png[/img]

Salute, Pilots!

We are launching a new demo for our digital mecha-diorama-building tool titled Kriegsfront Battlecaper. This is only a tool for you Pilots, where self-made mecha (dubbed: Krieger) and custom levels can be made. Let’s create your own mecha warfare diorama from the Kriegsfront universe!  

[b]The demo will only be available for a limited time until 19 January 10am PT.[/b]

[h3][b]Kriegsfront Battlescaper[/b][/h3]
This tool is a completely free-to-play digital toy (no added costs for sure) where you can make your own battlefield dioramas. Utilize our built-in developer tools such as[b] Krieger builder, level editor, and photo mode[/b] intended for the upcoming Kriegsfront Tactics.

[b]Come and let’s create your ideal warfare.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41787510/32ef07a809a107361ed9778ec9b8194146bc657b.gif[/img]
[i]A personalized Krieger makes the Pilot feel confident on the battlefield![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41787510/b06af44f750ee221707d7b609e8e0f38b73648e4.gif[/img]
[i]Create your own Kriegsfront level with freedom![/i]

[h3][b]Features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Create and customize your own Kriegers with our versatile mech building tools
[*] Equip them with weapons and pose them with our built-in animation presets
[*] Create and customize your battlefield
[*] Put your Kriegers inside the custom created battlefield
[*] Memorize your creation with our built-in photo mode
[/list]
[h3][b]What to expect? [/b][/h3]
This is a first showcase demo of what you can get from Kriegsfront Battlescaper. You can expect more Kriegsfront Tactics world-building based on this level editor. The full version of this tool will be coming out soon with improvements and additions like:
[list]
[*] More Kriegers and their parts
[*] More weapons
[*] More animations
[*] Better UI and UX
[*] Completely free!
[/list]
Stay safe and godspeed, Pilots. 

The Kriegsfront Team.
